svg.text: Does lead attention explain the near class-independent IG lead profile?
n = 160 (record, class) pairs from 157 ECG records; intervention: lead-attention gates -> one uniform gate per record (in memory only)
A. Actual lead-attention gate by lead (mean over records, bars = +/- 1 sd)
gate sd across records: max 0.0e+00; lead-to-lead sd of the mean gate 0.032; max |mean of z-scored input| 3.2e-08
B. Mean IG lead share: original vs uniform attention
C1. Per-class mean IG lead share, original
C2. Per-class mean IG lead share, uniform attention
D. Class information in the lead profile (record-clustered 95% CI)
original: raw cosine within 0.961 vs between 0.957; centred cosine within 0.091 vs between -0.007 (difference 0.098 [0.046, 0.157])
leave-one-record-out class identification from the centred lead share: 0.169 [0.113, 0.230] (chance 0.125)
intervened: raw cosine within 0.962 vs between 0.957; centred cosine within 0.095 vs between -0.009 (difference 0.104 [0.052, 0.163])
leave-one-record-out class identification from the centred lead share: 0.200 [0.139, 0.263] (chance 0.125)
